title: feat(app-shell): retire StudioHomePage; the Studio app root opens its first navigation entry (objectui#12113)
body:
Fixes #12113
Clause-②: no

Executes ruling A1 (comment 6105451919, maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-11): `StudioHomePage` retires, and the Studio app's root resolves to the app's own first navigation item, like every other app's.

## The first item, named

The platform's Studio app (objectstack `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/studio.app.ts`, read on objectstack `main`) opens its navigation with the `group_overview` group, whose first child is `nav_app_builder`: label **App Builder**, `type: 'component'`, `componentRef: 'studio:builder'`. `resolveHref` builds `/component/studio/builder` for it, so the Studio root now navigates to **`/apps/studio/component/studio/builder`**. The console binds `studio:builder` to `BuilderLanding` (`apps/console/src/registerStudioComponents.tsx`).

## What changed

- **The walk** (`findFirstRoute` in `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`) lands on `component` entries too. It already built every candidate's URL through `buildItemRoute`, which calls `@object-ui/layout`'s `resolveHref`, the builder the sidebar's `NavigationRenderer` uses. No second copy of the component URL rule was written (H2).
- **The index route's last fallback** (`return` of `StudioHomePage`) is gone, with the lazy import. An app that serves navigation but has no landing (all its entries are `url`, `action` or `doc` links, or they live only under `areas`, which the resolver does not walk) now renders no page at its root. The sidebar still offers its entries. Before this change such an app got `StudioHomePage`.
- **Deleted:** `StudioHomePage.tsx`, its export from `views/metadata-admin/index.ts`, and its two tests (`StudioHomePage.displayLocale-10232`, `StudioHomePage.recentPackage-11863`). Both pinned page-only behaviour.
- **Sidebar:** the Studio-only Home row and `isStudioHomeActive` are gone. The memo that carries the package scope stays; it now only feeds the package-management link, and is renamed `studioScopeSearch`.
- **Readers re-pointed:** `useRecentItemLabel.ts` and `ContextSelectors.tsx` no longer name the page; `AppNoAccessEmptyState.tsx` keeps its history sentence and says the page is retired; the `appServesNoNavigation.ts` note is reworded (H5).
- **Strings (H4):** the `engine.home.*` keys live only in the metadata-admin string table (`views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`), not in the `@object-ui/i18n` packs: the packs' `home.*` block is the console Home page's, and no pack has an `engine` namespace. 22 keys are removed from both the en and zh tables. `engine.home.recent` stays, because `BuilderLanding` reads it. Three of the 22 (`issuesHint`, `openDiagnostics`, `viewDomain`) had no reader before this change either. No pack moves, so `TranslationKeys` does not change, and there is no `@object-ui/i18n` bump.
- **Docs (H6):** in `content/docs/guide/console.md`, only the "Studio Package Scope" row described the retired page (its "Studio home … quick-create links"). The "Studio home" in the "Package-less Flows" and "Read-only Packages" rows is the `/studio` builder landing (`BuilderLanding`: "Not in a package", "Installed (read-only · browsable)"), so those rows stay. `packages/app-shell/README.md`'s package-scope paragraph is corrected the same way.

## Measured consequences beyond Studio

The walk change applies to every app, which is the ruling's "like every other app's". Two platform apps put a `component` entry first and change landing:

- **Account:** the first entry is `nav_account_profile` (`account:profile_card`), which its producer's own comment calls "the canonical landing". The root opened Notifications (`sys_inbox_message/view/mine`) before this change, as the ablation run below shows, and now opens Profile.
- **Setup**, for a caller whose server-filtered navigation lacks the `manage_platform_settings`-gated Overview group: the first remaining entry is `nav_packages` (`developer:packages`) in the Apps group, which the walk used to skip.

An app whose first entry is an object, page, dashboard or report entry is unchanged (pinned), and an app serving no navigation still gets `AppNoAccessEmptyState` (pinned).

## The preview mirror (H3)

`AppPreview.findFirstLanding` already took any entry with an in-app href, a `component` entry included, so for the Studio app the designer preview named a landing the runtime did not open. The preview needs no code change. Its comment, and the test name in `AppPreview.docEntry-11197.test.tsx` that listed the runtime's landing types, are updated, and `AppPreview.componentLanding-12113.test.tsx` pins the preview side on the same order.

## Pins

- `AppContent.studioRootLanding-12113.test.tsx`:
  - the Studio root navigates to `/apps/studio/component/studio/builder`;
  - a `component` entry ahead of an `object` entry wins;
  - CONTROL: an object-first app lands where it did;
  - CONTROL: an app with no navigation gets `AppNoAccessEmptyState`;
  - a url-only app stays on its root with no empty state.
- `UnifiedSidebar.studioNoHome-12113.test.tsx`:
  - the Studio sidebar has no Home row and no link to the bare app root;
  - the App Builder is its first link;
  - CONTROL: package management keeps `?package=`, and the directory entry stays hidden.
- `AppContent.emptyNavigationLanding-12079.test.tsx`: its Studio control now asserts the landing on the first entry, not the page.
- The five other tests that stubbed `StudioHomePage` lose the stub key (3 console, 2 app-shell). In `AppContent.systemHubRoutes.test.tsx` (epic objectui#7611's territory) only that line changes.

## Ablation

The walk's `component` arm was removed through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, run in wrap mode on committed `6e2bcdb`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `de6111db995f` to `9cf3415350cb`, on-disk `item.type === 'component'` count 0. Result: 3 red, 10 green.

- Red: the Studio root pin, the component-first pin (which then landed on `/apps/account/sys_inbox_message/view/mine`) and the 12079 Studio control.
- Green: every control.

Restore: blob `de6111db995f` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Also touched, beyond the claim's file list

- `.changeset/12079-empty-nav-landing.md`: its pending "Unchanged" bullet ("The Studio app still opens on its own home") goes false with this change, and would otherwise publish beside this change's entry in the same release. It is reworded so that it stays true in both trees. `pnpm check:changeset-claims` exists to prompt this re-read. The package names are untouched, and `check:changeset-overwrite` is report-only.
- `packages/app-shell/README.md` and `AppPreview.docEntry-11197.test.tsx`, as above.

## Acceptance notes

These are not filed.

- `AppHeader.tsx`'s Profile menu item explains its explicit component route with "the bare app path does not reliably resolve to the first (component-type) nav item". After this change, the bare path does resolve to it. The link itself stays correct. Carrier: none.
- The Studio root no longer shows the ⌘⇧M quick-find hint or a "Browse all metadata" button. The metadata directory stays reachable from the "All types" breadcrumb on every metadata list and editor (`PageShell`), and `MetadataQuickFind` is still mounted by `DirectoryPage`.
- `Navigate` to the landing drops the root URL's query, as it does for every app. A `/apps/studio?package=...` deep link opens the App Builder unscoped, the same as clicking the sidebar's App Builder entry, which carries no params.
- No deployment deep link to the Studio root was measured (the ruling's second confidence gap). Such a link keeps resolving, now to the App Builder.

## Verification

Every run below is on head `4957032`, the merge of `origin/main` `faf4ce9` into `6e2bcdb`. The merge was clean; it auto-merged `packages/app-shell/README.md` and `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`. Every build and test run went through the shared verify lock. Seconds are shared-box seconds.

- **Build:** `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --concurrency=2` built 34 of 34 tasks. This is the dependency closure of both `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check && pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` gives lock VERDICT command-exit 0. The app-shell test program (`tsconfig.test.json`, read with `--listFilesOnly`) includes all five new or edited app-shell test files.
- **Pins, touched tests and ratchets:** one run of `pnpm exec vitest run` over these files:
  - the three new pin files;
  - `AppContent.emptyNavigationLanding-12079`, `AppPreview.docEntry-11197`, `AppContent.noAppComponentRoutes` and `AppContent.pseudoRouteSegments`;
  - the three console tests;
  - `column-identity.ratchet.test.ts` and `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`.

  Result: 12 files passed, 129 tests passed.
- **app-shell, narrowed (declared):** the 238 app-shell test files that name a touched module were run in three parts. The modules searched for are `AppContent`, `UnifiedSidebar`, `ContextSelectors`, `useRecentItemLabel`, `appServesNoNavigation`, `AppNoAccessEmptyState`, `AppPreview`, `ConsoleLayout`, the metadata-admin barrel and its `i18n` table.
  - Parts: 88 files / 651 tests, 74 / 971 and 76 / 713, all passed.
  - The full package suite has 1270 files. The rest is left to CI.
  - The same 238 also passed on `6e2bcdb` before the merge.
- **Console suite:** `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/` in 4 shards ran 46 / 473, 46 / 689, 45 / 420 and 45 / 480 files / tests, all passed.
- **Root suite:** `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/` in 4 shards ran 45 / 1254, 45 / 1740, 45 / 1391 and 45 / 1104 files / tests, all passed, with 2 files skipped by their own guards.
- **Lint:** objectui's form is `eslint .` with inline config honoured. On the 19 touched `.ts` / `.tsx` files it reports 0 errors and 63 warnings. None of the warnings is on a line this diff adds.
- **i18n family:** all exit 0.
  - `check:i18n-keys`.
  - `check:i18n-drift`: the packs have 0 keys added or removed; the designer table has 22 removed.
  - `check:i18n-dead-keys`: no `engine.home` key is among its candidates.
  - `check:i18n-designer-parity`: "Every en row has a zh row".
  - `check:eager-locale-catalogues`: only `en` is eager.
- **Eager closure:** measured with a console build of this head and a console build of `faf4ce9`, made in a throwaway worktree that has since been removed. The difference:
  - eager gzip: 3253929 to 3252103 bytes, a change of -1826;
  - eager raw: 10942678 to 10939144 bytes, a change of -3534;
  - eager chunks: 291 to 289; total chunks: 2474 to 2472.

  The shrink is the eager `i18n` chunk losing the 44 removed strings (-2254 raw), plus two small shared chunks (`RecentItemsProvider`, `UserStateAdapters`) folding into their importers once the page no longer shares them. `check:eager-closure` on this head is green.
- **Repo checks, all exit 0:**
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: 1 changeset declared;
  - `check:changeset-claims`: report-only. It names `.changeset/11806-login-server-unreachable.md`, whose paragraph about the README's sign-up table this edit does not reach (re-read);
  - `check:pending-changeset-literals`;
  - `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new;
  - `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots` and the three `check:vi-mock-*`;
  - `check:phantom-deps`;
  - `docs:check-links`.
- **`check:readme-exports`** exits 1 only on `packages/cli` and `packages/plugin-ai`. Both are outside the built closure, so their `dist` is absent. NOT MEASURED for those two READMEs. The 581 self-imports it judged, the app-shell README's among them, have 0 wrong-path and 0 fabricated.
- **Ablation:** see above. It ran on `6e2bcdb`; the merge did not touch `AppContent.tsx`.
